code: s >> head.width; s >> head.height; s >> head.pixel_size; s >> head.flags;
note: The TGA header fields including dimensions and pixel size are read directly from the input stream and select a one-pixel 24-bit true-color image.
The input-controlled width, height, and pixel size determine that three image bytes are expected.
The code does not verify that the requested raw pixel byte count was actually read, so a truncated file leaves bytes in the heap image buffer uninitialized.
The conversion of the 24-bit pixel reads the uninitialized raw image bytes when the file ended before supplying them.
